caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #104: COMPLICIT

complicit (adjective): involved with others in wrongdoing.

✅ In a sentence: By staying silent, the manager became complicit in the cover-up.
✅ Similar: implicated, involved, guilty
✅ Remember it: Noun: complicity.
